visual_action: A slideshow of four professional photographs of Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear and his family. The first photo shows Beshear in a wood-paneled office. The second is a black and white photo of the family outdoors, with one of his children playing the violin. The third shows Beshear and his wife, Britainy Beshear, embracing in a doorway. The final photo shows the couple relaxing and talking in a living room with their dog.
